labels.variantDefinition: A long run of full-width poster compositions, each a self-contained graphic piece set in the family, often in a period style
labels.look: Flat retro colour fields (orange, blue, brown), Bauhaus/Futura-era layouts, big alphabet up top
labels.learn: Let each poster pastiche a period the design references; the posters tell the story without any prose

labels.variantDefinition: The hero is a headline sentence about the font, set in the font: the pitch and the specimen are the same object
labels.look: Cyan field, condensed headline left in white/green, giant compressed 'M' right, nav top and bottom
labels.learn: Pair the claim ('not just condensed') with one giant glyph that proves it

labels.variantDefinition: Family name and a short line set large over a full-bleed photograph that sets the mood
labels.look: Photo of a weathered fence with aspen trees; big semi-transparent wordmark, italic intro
labels.ux: Text is editable in place ('click any text to edit'); arrows flip through pages like slides
labels.learn: Make every specimen string editable, so the hero is quietly also a tester

labels.variantDefinition: A thin site-wide banner above the content (donation drive, launch, sale), not part of the specimen
labels.learn: Host organisation chrome competes with the specimen; keep it thin

labels.variantDefinition: The family name set as large as the viewport allows on a flat field, with little or nothing else
labels.look: White INFINI on black, full width; info bar with credits and a DOWNLOAD button; anchor nav
labels.ux: Download CTA in the hero; anchor nav (project, story, studies, try it)
labels.learn: A credits strip under the wordmark (designer, commissioner) gives instant provenance

labels.variantDefinition: Photograph of physical material (paper, textile, objects) carrying or framing the type
labels.look: Grey still life of paper sheets, vertical text printed on a sheet, giant type cropped at the bottom
labels.learn: Show the font printed on the paper it was made for; the material does the branding

labels.variantDefinition: The whole site is a single-screen app driven by keyboard shortcuts; sections are app states, not scroll positions
labels.look: Monospace UI, grey, numbered section tabs, key legend along the bottom
labels.ux: Arrow keys navigate, keys toggle weight, italic, light/dark, zoom; text fields editable
labels.learn: For a coding font, let visitors use it the way they will use it: from the keyboard

labels.variantDefinition: A collage of designed artefacts (documents, tickets, packaging, diagrams) all set in the typeface, implying a fictional world
labels.look: Letters, boarding passes, receipts, departure boards; monochrome with a pale green accent
labels.learn: Invent a fictional world (here, a space agency) and design its paperwork; every prop is a specimen

labels.variantDefinition: The name built from letters in many different styles/colours of the family, showing range at a glance
labels.look: Each letter of EXCELSIORAMA in a different style and colour on black
labels.learn: A wordmark that mixes the styles is a one-glance family overview
